verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents its own Blob Storage Export for exporting large data volumes on a schedule, plus SDK/API query access. It is MIT-licensed and self-hostable, which reduces lock-in. However, the evidence never names the export file formats and never says that all data types (prompts, datasets, scores, traces) are covered. One hands-on user also found the retrieval API 'brutally slow' for bulk scanning and queried the database directly instead. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV/Parquet), evidence that export covers all data types, a documented full-account export or migration path, and independent corroboration of a complete export.
